title: Composer accepts cleartext package downloads
description: composer.json declares `secure-http` turned off, which permits http downloads. Any repository URL can be served over cleartext, so a network attacker can replace the archive and its metadata.
remediation: Leave `secure-http` enabled and serve every repository over https.
limitation: It matches `secure-http` turned off, which permits http downloads in the parsed composer.json; it cannot tell whether the package is installed, whether any published version is affected by an advisory, or whether the dependency reaches production code.
